items.exampleEn: Filling in the same form again and again is tiresome.
items.exampleZh: 一再填寫同一張表格很煩人。

items.exampleEn: She was mortified when her phone rang during the quiet test.
items.exampleZh: 安靜的考試中她的手機響了，她覺得非常難堪。

items.exampleEn: My brother is fascinated by old trains.
items.exampleZh: 我弟弟對老火車非常著迷。

items.exampleEn: He's so stingy that he never buys anyone a drink.
items.exampleZh: 他小氣到從來不請別人喝一杯。

items.exampleEn: Her benevolence showed in the way she treated every animal.
items.exampleZh: 從她對待每隻動物的方式，就看得出她的仁慈。

items.exampleEn: The farmer called his trusty dog to help with the sheep.
items.exampleZh: 農夫叫來他那隻可靠的狗幫忙趕羊。

items.exampleEn: His truthfulness earned him the respect of his colleagues.
items.exampleZh: 他的誠實贏得了同事們的尊敬。

items.exampleEn: My bossy little sister always decides what game we play.
items.exampleZh: 我那愛指使人的妹妹總是決定我們玩什麼遊戲。

items.sentenceEn: I still ride my trusty old bike to work every day.
items.sentenceZh: 我每天還是騎那台可靠的舊腳踏車上班。

items.audioEn: My uncle is so stingy that he uses the same tea bag three times.
items.audioZh: 我叔叔小氣到同一個茶包要用三次。

items.sentenceEn: The children were fascinated by the huge whale bones in the museum.
items.sentenceZh: 孩子們被博物館裡巨大的鯨魚骨頭深深吸引。

items.sentenceEn: Don't be stingy with praise; a kind word costs nothing.
items.sentenceZh: 別吝於稱讚別人，一句好話不用花錢。

items.stemEn: He's so ____ that he even tells his older brothers how to do their jobs.
items.stemZh: 他愛指使人到連哥哥們該怎麼做事都要管。

items.stemEn: The poor family never forgot the ____ of the shop owner who gave them free bread.
items.stemZh: 那個貧困家庭從未忘記那位送他們免費麵包的店主的仁慈。

items.passageEn: Last semester, I had to do a group project with three classmates. One of them, Nina, was very bossy and gave everyone orders. Our meetings were tiresome, because she wanted to control every detail. Once, she even read my notes aloud to the whole group, which mortified me. I tried to hide my irritation, and later I told her how I felt. To my surprise, she listened carefully, and after that our team worked much better.
items.passageZh: 上學期，我得和三位同學做小組報告。其中一位叫 Nina，非常愛指使人，總是對大家發號施令。我們的會議很累人，因為她想掌控每個細節。有一次，她甚至把我的筆記念給全組聽，讓我非常難堪。我努力掩飾自己的惱怒，後來告訴她我的感受。出乎意料的是，她認真聽了，之後我們這組合作得好多了。

questions.questionZh: 小組會議為什麼很累人？
作者告訴 Nina 感受後發生了什麼？
options: 她很生氣地離開了會議室

items.promptZh: 我爸在超市裡大聲唱歌，讓我覺得好丟臉。
referenceEn: My dad mortified me by singing loudly in the supermarket.
I was mortified when my dad sang loudly in the supermarket.
rubricZh: 要用 mortify（例如 mortified me、I was mortified）
句型例如主動句、被動句等都可以
時態合理即可（例如 mortified、sang、mortifies 等）

items.instructionZh: 用 truthfulness 造一個句子，說說你怎麼看待誠實，或某人誠實的表現。
referenceEn: I value truthfulness more than politeness in a friend.
My teacher praised my truthfulness when I admitted my mistake.
rubricZh: 句子要用到 truthfulness 當名詞（例如 value truthfulness、praised my truthfulness）
時態配合內容（例如 value、praised 等）
